moments.author: Mohamed Salah
moments.why: A two‑emoji reply to a fan post boasting his decade of elite attacking metrics went wildly viral—over 2.8M views—making Salah’s minimalist style a trending moment among football and cultural fans.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: I was just thinking that (for myself) stupidity doesn’t count unless I’m also really obstinate about it
moments.why: One of Musk’s typically cryptic and self‑reflective tweets drew ~3M views in 24h, fueling debate among tech/business‑minded users.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Hear me out: “Singularity dot Com”, a dating site for digital superintelligences …
moments.why: Musk’s off‑the‑wall pitch for a dating site for digital superintelligences clocked ~2.9M views, capturing tech‑culture buzz.

moments.author: Elon Musk

moments.why: Musk’s provocative claim drew ~1.9M views, resonating across tech and business circles as a punchy cultural line.
